# HumanLayer show-me provenance

Repo Canon vendors the complete `show-me` skill directory from
[`humanlayer/skills` at commit `653b6411c1f70c275a18e37673b042ff99f67ceb`](https://github.com/humanlayer/skills/tree/653b6411c1f70c275a18e37673b042ff99f67ceb/plugins/show-me/skills/show-me).
The upstream path is `plugins/show-me/skills/show-me`; the local path is
`skills/show-me`. Both files are copied verbatim, including the optional HTML
output instructions in `SKILL.md` and the explicit invocation policy in
`agents/openai.yaml`. No other HumanLayer skills are selected.

The upstream root `LICENSE` is retained here without modification. Adoption
installs it beside the skills as `.agents/skills/LICENSE.humanlayer-skills`.
The conformance tests record independent SHA-256 hashes from the pinned
upstream checkout to verify the complete file inventory and bytes offline.

The [upstream-compatibility procedure](../../docs/development/upstream-compatibility.md)
describes verifying and updating this snapshot.
